title: Shields, crit, and resistance
hook: **Shields**, **crits**, and **resistance** are how hits fail, land soft, or land hard — the same combat language on the lawn and in later battles.

blindSpots.meaning: An element-typed absorb pool that takes RPG damage before HP. Not a flavour bar and not the lawn plant’s armour sprite.
A hit that lands hard when the roll says so — not a separate damage type.
Hits can fail. Absence of damage is a real outcome, not a UI glitch.
Two-phase: a status can fail to apply, or apply weaker. Not “immune forever” by default.
One damage path produces the number. Lawn and server battles share that honesty.

alsoTrue: Internal cooldowns stop the same interaction from chaining into soup.
You read shields and statuses under pressure on the [lawn unit HUD](lawn-mirror-hud).

sections.title: What it is
paras: Layered defence in front of health, plus hit outcomes that can miss or crit.
Resistance is about statuses failing or landing soft — not a second health bar.

sections.title: How it works

cards.name: Shields
cards.body: Element-typed pools absorb RPG damage before it reaches HP.

cards.name: Hits
cards.body: Can miss. Can crit. One resolver writes the damage number.

cards.name: Resistance
cards.body: A status may fail to stick, or stick weaker. Cooldowns keep chains honest.

diagram: hit  ->  (miss?)  ->  shields absorb  ->  remaining to HP
status apply  ->  resist fail / weaker / full

groups.title: On the board and in builds
steps: During a lawn match, open Lawn and read shield and status chips on the unit HUD.
Build for crit and resist through gear, [aptitudes](aptitudes), and specimen traits — not by inventing a private chart.
In later battles, expect the same words: shield, miss, crit, resist.
groups.note: Exact rates move with balance. Trust the feedback on screen.

doSteps: Start a lawn match with the control room open on Lawn.
Find a unit with a shield chip and watch it take hits before HP moves.
Note a status that fails to stick or lands soft — that is resistance talking.
doNote: Statuses themselves: [statuses](statuses). Element story: [six elements and omni](element-ring).

mixUps.q: Is a shield the same as plant armour in the base game?
mixUps.a: No. Overlay shields are RPG absorb pools typed by element — read them on the unit HUD.

mixUps.q: Do lawn and web fights use different damage math?
mixUps.a: No. One resolver — same honesty in both places.
Not by default. Resist can mean fail-to-apply or apply-weaker.

mixUps.q: Can I stack the same proc forever?
mixUps.a: Internal cooldowns exist so the same interaction does not soup the board.

mixUps.q: Where do I build for crit?
mixUps.a: Gear, aptitudes, and specimen traits — watch combat feedback rather than a secret table.
